templates.title: Crisis Communication Deck
templates.description: Empathy-first structure for layoffs, incidents, outages, and regulatory announcements. Lead with empathy, state facts, explain actions, give next update.

templates.title: Succession Planning Brief
templates.description: Leadership pipeline review with readiness assessments, development plans, and timeline for key role transitions.

templates.title: Company Vision and Mission
templates.description: Articulate where the company is going. Vision, mission, values, strategic pillars, and 3-year horizon. For all-hands and town halls.

templates.title: Budget Approval Deck
templates.description: Present your budget request with ROI projections, resource allocation, risk analysis, and phased spending plan.

templates.title: DEI Progress Report
templates.description: Diversity, equity, and inclusion metrics with year-over-year trends, initiatives, and action items.

templates.title: Series A Pitch Deck
templates.description: Post-seed pitch deck with product-market fit evidence, unit economics, growth metrics, and use of funds. 12-slide Sequoia format.

templates.title: Series B Growth Deck
templates.description: Growth-stage pitch with scaled metrics, expansion strategy, competitive moat, and path to profitability.

templates.title: Angel Investor Deck
templates.description: Early-stage pitch for angel investors. Problem, solution, team, early traction, and ask. Concise 10-slide format.

templates.title: YC Application Deck
templates.description: Y Combinator style application deck. What you do, why now, team, traction, and what you need.

templates.title: Exit Strategy Deck
templates.description: M&A or IPO readiness deck with valuation, comparable analysis, strategic fit, and transaction timeline.

templates.title: Product Launch Deck
templates.description: Launch plan with positioning, messaging, channel strategy, timeline, and success metrics.

templates.title: Brand Strategy Deck
templates.description: Brand positioning, visual identity guidelines, tone of voice, audience segmentation, and competitive differentiation.

templates.title: Customer Onboarding Deck
templates.description: Welcome new customers. Product overview, getting started steps, key contacts, timeline to value, and support resources.

templates.title: Annual Marketing Plan
templates.description: Full-year marketing strategy with budget allocation, channel mix, campaign calendar, KPIs, and team structure.

templates.title: Sales Enablement Deck
templates.description: Arm your sales team. Ideal customer profile, objection handling, competitive positioning, pricing guide, and demo script.

templates.title: Design Review Deck
templates.description: UX/UI design review with user research findings, wireframes, design decisions, accessibility notes, and next steps.

templates.title: API Documentation Deck
templates.description: Developer-facing API overview. Endpoints, authentication, rate limits, code examples, and integration guide.

templates.title: System Migration Plan
templates.description: Legacy to modern system migration. Current state, target architecture, migration phases, risk mitigation, and rollback plan.

templates.title: Incident Response Deck
templates.description: Post-incident review with timeline, root cause, impact assessment, remediation steps, and prevention measures.

templates.title: Performance Benchmark Deck
templates.description: System performance metrics. Latency, throughput, uptime, error rates, compared against SLAs and industry benchmarks.

templates.title: Vendor Evaluation Deck
templates.description: Compare vendors side by side. Scoring criteria, feature comparison, pricing analysis, references, and recommendation.

templates.title: Change Readiness Assessment
templates.description: Assess organizational readiness for change. Stakeholder analysis, impact assessment, communication plan, and training needs.

templates.title: Quarterly Operations Review
templates.description: End-of-quarter operational performance. KPIs, process improvements, team capacity, cost optimization, and next quarter priorities.

templates.title: Compliance Audit Deck
templates.description: Audit findings, risk ratings, remediation timeline, and compliance status across regulatory requirements.

templates.title: Data Privacy Impact Assessment
templates.description: GDPR/CCPA privacy impact assessment. Data flows, risk evaluation, consent mechanisms, and compliance roadmap.

templates.title: ML Model Deployment Deck
templates.description: Model deployment plan. Training data, evaluation metrics, A/B test results, monitoring strategy, and rollout phases.

templates.title: Analytics Dashboard Review
templates.description: Present your analytics insights. Dashboard walkthrough, key metrics, trends, anomalies, and recommended actions.

templates.title: AI Ethics Framework
templates.description: Responsible AI principles. Bias detection, fairness metrics, transparency requirements, and governance structure.

templates.title: Smart Slides: Datacenter Architecture
templates.description: Live adaptive datacenter pitch. Audience shares RPO, RTO, and budget during the meeting. Architecture and pricing slides regenerate in real-time. Uses live_input and adaptive_block.

templates.title: Smart Slides: Voice-Adaptive Pricing
templates.description: Voice-powered sales deck. Speak naturally with the customer. AI extracts headcount, region, and tier from the conversation and regenerates pricing, ROI, and implementation timeline slides. Uses voice_input and adaptive_block.
